passages.text: Our drama group is showing visitors how to use the new changing area behind the stage. From the hall door, they turn left at the noticeboard and follow the blue arrows. Inside, each performer can take off an outdoor coat and hang it on a numbered hook. Mia tests the instructions with a younger pupil on his first visit to the room. He finds the door easily but cannot see the numbers hidden behind some hanging scarves. We move the labels above the hooks, making the whole route clearer for the next show.

parallelText.en: Our drama group is showing visitors how to use the new changing area behind the stage.
parallelText.zh: 我们戏剧组向访客介绍舞台后新更衣区的用法。

parallelText.en: From the hall door, they turn left at the noticeboard and follow the blue arrows.
parallelText.zh: 从大厅门口，他们在布告栏处左转，跟着蓝箭头走。

parallelText.en: Inside, each performer can take off an outdoor coat and hang it on a numbered hook.
parallelText.zh: 进去后，每位表演者可以脱下外套，挂在编号挂钩上。

parallelText.en: Mia tests the instructions with a younger pupil on his first visit to the room.
parallelText.zh: 米娅请一位第一次来到这间房间的小同学试用说明。

parallelText.en: He finds the door easily but cannot see the numbers hidden behind some hanging scarves.
parallelText.zh: 他很容易找到门，却看不到被几条围巾遮住的号码。

parallelText.en: We move the labels above the hooks, making the whole route clearer for the next show.
parallelText.zh: 我们把标签移到挂钩上方，让下次演出的整条路线更清楚。

wordHelp.meaning: a curved object used for hanging things

passages.text: A few pupils volunteer to check the supplies before our class cleans the community garden. Each team will receive gloves, a rubbish bag and a bottle of water for the afternoon. Ben compares the list with the boxes and finds that one team has no gloves. Rather than starting that team early, he asks an adult helper to bring another set. While they wait, Mia explains which garden paths must stay clear for other visitors. The short supply check prevents confusion and helps everyone begin with the equipment they need.

parallelText.en: A few pupils volunteer to check the supplies before our class cleans the community garden.
parallelText.zh: 几位学生自愿在班级清扫社区花园前检查用品。

parallelText.en: Each team will receive gloves, a rubbish bag and a bottle of water for the afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 每队下午会领到手套、垃圾袋和一瓶水。

parallelText.en: Ben compares the list with the boxes and finds that one team has no gloves.
parallelText.zh: 本比较清单与箱子，发现一队没有手套。

parallelText.en: Rather than starting that team early, he asks an adult helper to bring another set.
parallelText.zh: 他没有让那队提前开工，而是请成年助手再拿一套。

parallelText.en: While they wait, Mia explains which garden paths must stay clear for other visitors.
parallelText.zh: 等待时，米娅说明哪些花园小路需要保持畅通，供其他访客通行。

parallelText.en: The short supply check prevents confusion and helps everyone begin with the equipment they need.
parallelText.zh: 这次简短物资检查避免了混乱，让大家带齐所需设备再开始。
